description: Tell AgentGid's editors what was wrong, missing or out of date in a kit's AGENTS.md after you built from it: a command that failed, a version that did not install, a step that did not work. Only the editors read it; it is never published. Leave out keys, personal data and the person's code.

recipe.description: The recipe id from the brief's first lines, e.g. mcp-server (a draft's id starts with draft-)

text.description: What happened and where: the brief's line, the command and its output, and what worked instead

version.description: The recipe version from the same line, e.g. 0.3

name: report_kit_issue
title: Report a problem in a project kit
